title: Just Say Hi
fullPrompt: Look into the lens, say hi, then say your name and one thing you did today.
tips: Look at the camera lens, not your own face.
You do not need to rewatch it.

title: Twenty Seconds
fullPrompt: Talk for 20 seconds about something you like — food, a game, a place, a camera, anything.
tips: Pick the first topic that comes to mind.
Finishing matters more than sounding polished.

title: Your Day in 30
shortPrompt: Tell one tiny story from today.
fullPrompt: Tell the camera the most interesting part of your day in around 30 seconds.
tips: Choose one moment, not your whole day.
Start with what happened.

title: No Delete
fullPrompt: Record for 30 seconds. Finish your thought before deciding whether it was good.
tips: A pause is allowed.
Do not stop just because you stumble on one word.

title: Explain a Favorite
fullPrompt: Pick a movie, food, game, place, creator, or hobby. Explain why you like it.
tips: Give one concrete reason.
Talk as if you are recommending it to a friend.

title: Stand Up
fullPrompt: Record standing up and talk for 30 seconds while keeping your gaze near the lens.
tips: Relax your shoulders.
Do not force gestures.

title: Boss: One-Minute Recap
fullPrompt: Give a one-minute recap of your day in one recording.
tips: Pick 2–3 moments.
If you lose your train of thought, pause and continue.

title: Start Immediately
shortPrompt: Begin before your brain overthinks it.
fullPrompt: Press record and begin your first real sentence within three seconds.
tips: Skip the warm-up noises.
Start with the point.

title: No ‘Hey Guys’
fullPrompt: Start a short video without saying ‘hey guys’, ‘so’, or apologizing for recording.
tips: Try a statement or question.
Example: ‘I found something weird today.’

title: Tiny Story
fullPrompt: Tell one tiny story with a beginning, middle, and end in about 60 seconds.
tips: Start where something changes.
End with what happened or what you thought.

title: Use the Pause
fullPrompt: After your first sentence, pause for one full second before continuing.
tips: Do not fill the pause with ‘umm’.
Let the silence exist.

title: Slow It Down
shortPrompt: Speak a little slower on purpose.
fullPrompt: Explain something simple while deliberately speaking around 10% slower than normal.
tips: Finish word endings.
Do not stretch every word; use pauses instead.

title: Hands in Frame
fullPrompt: Record with your hands naturally visible while you explain something for 45 seconds.
tips: Do not choreograph gestures.
Keep attention on your message.

title: Boss: 90 Seconds, One Take
fullPrompt: Talk for 90 seconds about something you genuinely care about. Try to finish in one take.
tips: A mistake is not a reason to stop.
Use a pause when you need a second.

title: Near the Outside
shortPrompt: Bring the camera closer to the world.
fullPrompt: Record near an open window, balcony, or doorway for 30 seconds.
tips: Choose somewhere safe and comfortable.
The goal is simply to change the environment.
fallbackPrompt: Record near a different room entrance or window where the environment feels slightly less private.

title: Just Outside
fullPrompt: Step outside your room, home, or building and record for 30 seconds.
tips: A quiet hallway or garden counts.
You are not required to show strangers.
fallbackPrompt: Record in the least-private safe place available to you today.

title: Quiet Outdoor Spot
shortPrompt: Talk where the world can hear you a little.
fullPrompt: Find a comfortable outdoor spot and talk to the camera for 45 seconds.
tips: A terrace, garden, lane, or park works.
Keep other people's privacy in mind.
fallbackPrompt: Record near an open window or common area for 45 seconds.

title: Walk and Talk
fullPrompt: Walk slowly while recording yourself for 30 seconds.
tips: Watch where you are walking.
Choose a safe, obstacle-free route.
fallbackPrompt: Walk safely indoors through a hallway or room while recording.

title: Let the Background Move
shortPrompt: The world does not have to stop for your video.
fullPrompt: Record somewhere with ordinary movement in the background and keep talking.
tips: Do not point the camera at strangers.
Your job is to keep your sentence going.
fallbackPrompt: Record with a TV, window view, or safe household movement in the background.

title: Public Place, Quiet Corner
fullPrompt: Record a short clip from a low-pressure public place such as a park, lobby, campus, or quiet café corner.
tips: A quiet corner counts.
Choose a safe place and respect privacy.
fallbackPrompt: Use the most public-feeling safe place available to you today.

title: Boss: Outdoor One-Take
fullPrompt: Record 60 seconds outside and try to finish without restarting.
tips: Keep the topic simple.
If someone passes, continue normally.
fallbackPrompt: Record for 60 seconds in a semi-public common area without restarting.

title: Someone Might Notice
shortPrompt: Keep going even when you are not completely alone.
fullPrompt: Record while another person is somewhere in the environment, without pointing the camera at them.
tips: You do not need to interact with anyone.
Respect other people's privacy.
fallbackPrompt: Record where another person might reasonably enter the area, while keeping the camera on yourself.

title: Café Courage
fullPrompt: Record 30 seconds in a café or a similar public place. Keep the camera framed on yourself.
tips: A mall, campus, lobby, or park can substitute.
You never need to film strangers.
fallbackPrompt: Choose any safe public/common area and record 30 seconds.

title: Keep Talking
fullPrompt: Record in a public setting and keep speaking if someone happens to pass nearby.
tips: Do not wait for someone or film them intentionally.
The challenge is simply not stopping because the environment changes.
fallbackPrompt: Record with normal household/common-area movement around you and keep speaking.

title: One Minute in Public
shortPrompt: Hold the lens for a full minute.
fullPrompt: Stand or sit in a public place and record yourself for one minute.
tips: Choose a topic before pressing record.
A quiet public spot is completely valid.
fallbackPrompt: Use a semi-public safe space and record for one minute.

title: Show Me Where You Are
fullPrompt: Give the camera a short introduction to the place you are in and why you are there.
tips: Keep the camera primarily on yourself.
One or two environmental details are enough.
fallbackPrompt: Introduce the room or safe space you are currently in as if it were part of a vlog.

title: Creator Intro
fullPrompt: Give a 15-second opening hook, then continue the idea for another 30 seconds.
tips: Start with something specific.
Avoid apologizing for the video.
fallbackPrompt: Record the same creator-style intro in any safe space.

title: A Little Busier
shortPrompt: Increase the difficulty by one step.
fullPrompt: Record somewhere slightly busier than the public place you used before.
tips: Only increase difficulty a little.
Safety and privacy come first.
fallbackPrompt: Choose a safe place that feels one step less private than your last recording location.

title: 90-Second Public One-Take
fullPrompt: Record for 90 seconds in a public or semi-public place and try not to restart.
tips: Use a simple three-part structure.
Keep going through small mistakes.
fallbackPrompt: Record the 90-second one-take in the most public-feeling safe location available to you.

title: Final Boss: Mini Vlog
shortPrompt: Make the thing you came here to make.
fullPrompt: Create a two-minute mini-vlog in a public or semi-public place: intro, what you are doing, one observation, and a short sign-off.
tips: It does not need to be posted.
Keep other people out of frame when possible.
Finishing is the win.
fallbackPrompt: Record a two-minute mini-vlog from the least-private safe space available to you.
